integrity: Claims supported by exact cyclic-gap proof and independently enumerated small finite rings; finite computations do not establish infinite asymptotics. Scholarly priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Finite periodic equilibrium maximal-blockade arrays with one physically inert site; not sequential adsorption or coherent quantum evolution. The thermodynamic limit is taken before large blockade. Independent priority remains unassessed.
title: An exact one-site vacancy defect law for uniformly jammed Rydberg rings
